The '''Izvoshra''' were a cadre of only eight elite [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]], a number sacred to the Kaleesh, assembled and acted as a [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] for their [[Military rank/Legends|military leader]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] after the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Ronderu lij Kummar]]. The word "Izvoshra," given by Grievous, simply meant "elite" or "my elite." One of the eight elite warriors was [[Bentilais san Sk'ar]].

==History==
Though not formed into the "elite" until after the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Ronderu lij Kummar]] and Grievous's journey to [[Abesmi]], several of the Izvoshra had already been fighting at Grievous's side for [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. Among the Izvoshra was a [[Soldier/Legends|warrior]] found by Grievous while shipwrecked on [[Grendaju]], and believed to be from the same hunter race as Ronderu. Another was the revolutionary counterpart to Grievous, who fought on the other side of the planet, and another still was a former member of the [[Muja Bandits]] who used to desecrate [[Kalee/Legends|Kalee's]] sacred temples.<ref name="Lord" /> Each warrior was an almost unbeatable fighter, but were much more than that. Each warrior was a [[Khan/Legends|khan]] in charge of their own brigade of ''[[kolkpravis]]'' soldiers and they were chosen for their abilities and devotion to Kalee.<ref name="gaw">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref>

The Izvoshra followed Grievous in his very successful campaign of revenge during the [[Huk War]], slaughtering countless [[Yam'rii/Legends|Yam'rii]], driving them from Kalee and overrunning Huk colony [[Planet/Legends|worlds]]. After the war's abrupt defusal by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], Grievous became an enforcer for the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]], but the IBC refused to hire his elite. Instead, with the permission of [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], [[San Hill/Legends|San Hill]] commissioned a series of advanced [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuards]] to serve as replacements. After a time, Grievous grew so disgusted as he watched his homeworld suffer under Republic embargoes while the [[Huk/Legends|Huk]] went unpunished for their various atrocities, that he broke his contract with the IBC, gathered together the original Izvoshra aboard the ''[[Martyr]]'', and prepared to return to Kalee and reignite the war. The Izvoshra were all believed to have been killed aboard Grievous's ship when the Confederacy [[Crash of the Martyr|sabotaged]] it, planting an ion bomb aboard the shuttle that detonated above the [[Jenuwaa Sea]].<ref name="Lord" />

==Legacy==
After being rebuilt as a [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] and becoming the [[General/Legends|General]] of the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Droid Armies]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]],<ref name="EOR">''{{StoryCite|story=The Eyes of Revolution|book=Star Wars: Visionaries}}''</ref> Grievous personally trained his MagnaGuards and adorned them with Kaleesh cloaks and headwraps, in tribute to his original khans. Towards the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Grievous organized an experiment on the planet [[Nelvaan/Legends|Nelvaan]], where [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] scientists were mutating the native [[Nelvaanian/Legends|Nelvaanians]] in an attempt to produce powerful organic warriors. Intrigued by the similarity of the Nelvaanian people to the Kaleesh, Grievous may have intended to make some of these augmented Nelvaan warriors into his new elite forces. Any plan the general had in relation to them had to be scrapped when the subjects escaped and the testing was [[Battle of Nelvaan|destroyed]] by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].<ref name="CW25">{{CW|25}}</ref>

[[File:SkarCrushPunyPinkBoy-MSW53.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Bentilais san Sk'ar was the only surviving member of the Izvoshra.]]
The only Izvoshra member to survive the crash was [[Bentilais san Sk'ar]] gathered up the Kolkpravis and led the [[slaughter of the Yam'rii]] on [[Oben]] and [[Kaleesh Resistance|his people]] arriving at that resource-rich world. After the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] was compelled to [[Bombardment of Oben|bombard]] Oben as part of his [[Kaleesh–Imperial conflict|pacification]] of the Fringe territories, Sk'ar abandoned Kalee to serve for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]<ref name="gaw" /> as an [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial]] general.<ref name="Aliens in the Empire">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/97/indexp4.html|series=Aliens in the Empire|text=Part 2: To a Traitor Go the Spoils}}</ref> By [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="tcc">''[[Star Wars: The Comics Companion]]''</ref> Sk'ar had been tasked by the Empire to ferment conflict between the [[Twelve Tribes of T'Syriél]] and the [[Calian Confederacy]] so that their shared homeworld of [[Shiva IV]] could be more easily conquered. Sk'ar successfully recruited numerous [[T'Syriél]] outcasts into an elite task force of his own which he used to kidnap the Calian's current ruler, [[Aron Peacebringer]]. However, the general meddling caught the attention of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], resulting in several Rebel [[Agent/Legends|agents]] to be sent to stop Sk'ar's machinations.<ref name="M53">[[Star Wars (1977) 53|''Star Wars'' (1977) 53]]</ref> One of these agents, the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] warrior [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], succeeded in killing Sk'ar, bringing a final end to the Izvoshrsa.<ref name="M54">[[Star Wars (1977) 54|''Star Wars'' (1977) 54]]</ref>
